title: An exterior frame is not under-lit: enough of it reads as lit
note: An exterior or arena default frame is not under-lit: at least a fifth of its pixels read as lit. Dark interiors are exempt.
intent: The opposite failure to a missing black point: a scene so dark that nothing is legible and every judge answers no. An exterior needs a key (sun or moon, directional, with shadows), a sky-coloured fill so the shadow sides are not black, and bounce off the ground. Aim for a fifth of the frame reading as lit at minimum. A deliberately dark interior is exempt — say so in the facet's intent and drop the check rather than lifting the whole scene to satisfy it.

check.note: Exterior/arena default frame is not under-lit: >= 20% of pixels read as lit (seed floor; the skills only name under-lit / flat void as a loss). Dark interiors are exempt (near-black target).

port: The lighting facet sets key, fill and bounce for the exterior; interiors get their own facet and their own targets.
